runs.label: Running orders
runs.name: Name
runs.empty: No running orders yet. Build the cue list for the next show day.
runs.emptyReadOnly: No running orders yet. The stage manager builds them before each show.
runs.noMatch: No running orders match this search. Clear it to see them all.
runs.deleteBody: Its cues go with it. Called cues stay in the activity history.

cues.title: Cues
cues.label: Cue
cues.empty: No cues yet. Add the first cue of the show.
cues.moveBody: Choose its new place in the running order. Called cues keep their places.
cues.scriptHelp: What is said on the cue, up to 20,000 characters.
cues.calledViaLink: Called {time} by {name} through a showcaller link

live.title: Live
live.complete: Every cue is called. The show is complete.
live.completeSkipped: The show is complete. {count, plural, one {# skipped cue is} other {# skipped cues are}} still uncalled.
live.notStarted: No cue called yet. Call the first cue to start the show.
live.noPlan: The next cue has no planned time.
live.syncing: Updates every two seconds while live.
live.readOnly: You can follow the show; calling cues needs the stage manager's permission.

daySheets.label: Day sheets
daySheets.bodyHelp: The schedule and notes everyone works from that day.
daySheets.empty: No day sheets yet. Write the plan for the next production day.
daySheets.emptyReadOnly: No day sheets yet. They appear here once the production office writes them.
daySheets.trashed: Day sheet for {project}, {day}, moved to Trash.

callSheets.label: Call sheets
callSheets.noCalls: No shifts start this day. Build shifts in Crew to fill the call sheet.
callSheets.empty: No call sheets yet. Create one for the next show day; calls come from its shifts.
callSheets.emptyReadOnly: No call sheets yet. They appear here once a producer publishes them.
callSheets.trashed: Call sheet for {project}, {day}, moved to Trash.
callSheets.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No calls} one {# call} other {# calls}}

display.title: Display screens for {name}
display.description: A room clock, presenter timer or backstage screen on any TV or laptop, with no sign-in. It needs the link and its access code, and follows cues as they are called.
display.expiresHelp: Leave empty for the end of the day after the show. At most 90 days ahead.
display.noteHelp: For example, Stage left monitor. Never shown on the screen.
display.late: Running {minutes, plural, one {# min} other {# min}} late

console.label: Showcaller console
console.jumpBody: Choose the cue to put on standby. Cues you jump past are marked skipped once a later cue is called.
console.nudgeEarlierLabel: Nudge the remaining plan one minute earlier
console.nudgeLaterLabel: Nudge the remaining plan one minute later
console.keys: Keys answer while the console has focus. Stream Deck keys F13 to F20 work even with single-key shortcuts off.

segmentLibrary.label: Library segments
segmentLibrary.newBody: A block of cues you run in many shows, such as a walk-in, an awards block or a sponsor moment.
segmentLibrary.name: Segment name
segmentLibrary.empty: No library segments yet. Save a block you run in many shows and insert it into any running order.
segmentLibrary.emptyReadOnly: No library segments yet. People who edit running orders add them here.
segmentLibrary.noCues: This segment has no cues yet. Add the first one below.
segmentLibrary.deleteBody: The segment moves to Trash with its cues. Copies already in running orders stay as they are.
segmentLibrary.insertBody: Copies the segment's cues and department calls into this running order. You can edit the copies here afterwards.
segmentLibrary.emptyLibrary: The segment library is empty. Add segments in Show, Segment library.
segmentLibrary.startHelp: Optional. The copied cues are planned from this time and their lengths; leave it empty to plan them later.
segmentLibrary.libraryUpdated: Library updated: publish to shows to bring their copies up to date.
segmentLibrary.noCopies: No running order holds a copy of this segment yet.
segmentLibrary.publishWarning: Publishing replaces the uncalled cues of this segment in the chosen shows with the current version. Local edits to those cues, their custom field values included, are lost.

showChannel.title: Show channel
showChannel.clientsNever: Clients are never in this channel.
showChannel.notMember: You are not in this show channel.
showChannel.none: This project has no show channel yet.
showChannel.empty: No messages yet. Say hello to the crew.

showcallerLinks.title: Showcaller links for {name}
showcallerLinks.description: Let a showcaller without an account call this running order and edit it live, with a link and an access code.
showcallerLinks.warning: Anyone with this link and code can call cues and edit this running order until it expires.
showcallerLinks.callerNameHelp: Who will call the show. Shown beside each cue they call.
showcallerLinks.expiresHelp: Leave empty for the end of the day after the show. At most 14 days ahead.
showcallerLinks.expiresBeforeShow: This link expires before the show day ends.
showcallerLinks.noteHelp: For example, Guest caller for night one. Never shown on the portal.
showcallerLinks.devices: {count, plural, =0 {No devices} one {# device} other {# devices}}
showcallerLinks.regenerateConfirm: The link and code stop working now and every device must enter the new code. Regenerate?
showcallerLinks.signOutConfirm: Every device must enter the code again. Sign them out?
showcallerLinks.revokeConfirm: The link stops working for good. Revoke it?
